generate_proto_from_file: generate a _pb2.py Python module from a .proto file using the Protocol Compiler
build_protobuf_python_package: build the protobuf Python package by generating proto files and running setuptools build
clean_generated_files: clean the working directory by removing all generated _pb2.py, .pyc, .so, and .o files
run_conformance_tests: run the Python conformance test suite against the protobuf C++ implementation
get_protobuf_version: get the protobuf version string from the google/protobuf/__init__.py file
